rationale: The report includes a complete, offline-runnable reproduction, the uv version, and the exact error. The same PEP 723 script imports fine when run from its own directory and fails when run by path from elsewhere, which shows that a relative [[tool.uv.index]] url in an inline script block is resolved against the cwd rather than the script's directory. The docs (docs/concepts/indexes.md, flat indexes section) give a local path example but say nothing about how relative paths are resolved, so the contract is not explicit. I classify it as a bug because the inconsistency is plainly unintended for a self-contained script and a maintainer would likely treat it as a defect; the main alternative is enhancement, which is why confidence is medium. Two searches (symptom and root-cause wording) found no duplicate or related issues. No external cause is indicated.
